movelist.name: Discharge
movelist.effect: Discharge Paralyzes all legal targets on 15+.

movelist.name: Close Combat
movelist.effect: The user’s Defense and Special Defense are each lowered by -1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Plasma Fists
movelist.effect: The target’s next damaging Normal Type Move instead becomes Electric Type.

movelist.name: Quick Guard
movelist.effect: If the user or an adjacent ally is targeted by a Priority or Interrupt Attack, Quick Guard may be declared as an Interrupt, causing the triggering attack to have no effect.

movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Electric-Type attacks, and whenever they are hit with an Electric Type attack, they gain Hit Points equal to a Tick of Hit Points. Defensive.

abilities.name: Vicious
abilities.effect: Connection – Hone Claws. When this Ability is activated, choose one effect; the user gains another Standard Action this round; or the user increase their Critical Hit Range on all attacks by +2 for the remainder of the encounter.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.effect: The user increases the Damage Base of all Melee Moves by +2.
